vreason:
The mismatch is real: the 연어 마켓 screen depends on exact tag strings, and the guide never tells the model those strings are the tag.

Code side (/home/user/goei-plugin/src/ui/gnet.ts):
- :599 filters the list with `p.tag === gnet.cat`.
- :697 header tabs are `catBtn('삽니다','삽니다')` and `catBtn('정보','오컬트 정보')`.
- :788 and :888 show the "want" card (no picture) only when `p.tag === '삽니다'`.
- :667 shows 「가격 제안」 only for tag 삽니다; :666 and :793 treat tag 나눔 specially (green label).
- :684 `SM_TAGS = ['팝니다','삽니다','나눔']` is what the user's own write form offers.
- No normalisation exists: src/core/gnet.ts:755 and :977 only run `cleanTag`, and :299 cuts to 12 characters.

Guide side: I read the pinned request `gnet.refresh.sm` in tests/fixtures/guide-out-old.json. The only tag instruction is the shared POST.TAG_RULE (src/data/guides/gnet.txt:414, "one short category label in Korean, the way this board sorts its posts"). SALMON_TOPICS (src/core/guides.ts:74) says "Each post is a listing: 팝니다 (selling) or 삽니다 (buying)" but does not link that to the tag, and 나눔 appears only as a price wording. 정보 is not mentioned at all.

Effect: a model may tag by goods category (가전, 부적 and so on). Then 삽니다 posts render as sale cards with an item picture, the header 삽니다 tab is empty, and the 오컬트 정보 tab is always empty. The list bar at :797 still builds buttons from whatever tags exist, so the screen is degraded, not dead; medium severity stands.

The edit does not conflict with an owner decision. It is the minimal way to align the guide with the parser/UI: one sentence changed, about 20 tokens added, no dialogue example added. It is consistent with TAG_RULE ("the way this board sorts its posts") and with the price sentence that already lists 나눔.

One change to the finder's wording: 정보 is glossed as "occult information" to match the tab label 「오컬트 정보」; plain "information" is vaguer.

The 정보 part makes the model start producing a kind of post the guide did not ask for before. I found no owner statement about that tab (no docs mention; the tab arrived in merge commit b6839fce5). So that part is flagged for the owner; the 팝니다/삽니다/나눔 part needs no decision.

These are scale guides, not fixed floors or matched ratios: vary irregularly by age, topic and popularity, with upvotes below views. Spread posting times plausibly before narrative time so readership can accumulate; do not make every post seconds old with single-digit votes and tens of views. Existing counts never decrease and may grow with elapsed time and continued discussion.
evidence: 이 줄(128토큰, 실측)은 LB 절에 있어 새로고침뿐 아니라 글쓰기·댓글·글 하나 새로고침 요청에도 나간다(gnetPrompt.ts:211, :256). 그 세 요청의 출력 형식(PUBLIC.POST_FORMAT·PUBLIC.REACT_FORMAT, gnet.txt:187·192)에는 views/upvotes/date 칸이 없고, 새 글의 조회·추천은 앱이 정한다(ui/gnet.ts bumpStats). 다른 글의 증가는 ACTIVITY.GUIDELINE(197행)이 따로 다룬다. 또 괴담넷 소개(7행)는 「a closed forum used only by people inside the anomaly trade」인데 이 줄은 「an active public community」라 어긋난다. 새로고침에서만 읽는 BOARD.GUIDELINE 으로 옮기면 새로고침 요청문은 그대로이고 나머지 세 요청에서 128토큰씩 줄어든다.

v2.reasoning: The views/upvotes scale line (gnet.txt:72) is inside the LB section, and LB is sent to the refresh, post, comment and single-post-refresh requests (gnetPrompt.ts:177, 211, 256). In post/comment/refreshOne, the output formats (PUBLIC.POST_FORMAT, PUBLIC.REACT_FORMAT) have no views, upvotes or date fields. The app sets the user's new-post and single-post numbers itself (ui/gnet.ts bumpStats at 274/327/383). Increases on other posts are covered by ACTIVITY.GUIDELINE ('modest readership', non-negative deltas) and enforced in applyActivity. So in those three calls the line, with its absolute ranges and posting-time spreading, gives instructions the model has no field to act on. Only the refresh output (AUTO.FORMAT: views/upvotes/date per post) uses it. Moving it into BOARD.GUIDELINE, which only refreshPrompt reads (right after LB), keeps the refresh request's content the same and cuts 128 tokens from each post/comment/refreshOne call. The 'public community' vs 괴담넷 'closed forum' wording is a minor side point and not worth a separate edit; moving the line does not change it.

title_ko: 새로고침 한 번에 「댓글을 비우지 마라」가 다섯 번 나오고, 「여섯 개」「최소 없음」은 설정과 안 맞는다
old_text: Choose reception from each topic and its readership, not from a desire to minimize output. Use concise, natural comments rather than dropping discussions to save space. There is no per-post minimum. Saved threads are not capped at six; user-action reactions follow their separate contract.
evidence: 같은 새로고침 요청에 같은 뜻이 다섯 번 있다: 213행 「Zero comments is valid for an individual quiet post, not a default for every topic」, 213행 「Choose reception… not from a desire to minimize output. Use concise, natural comments rather than dropping discussions」, 120행 「individual quiet threads may have none. Preserve discussion when shortening output; do not default the entire board to empty comments arrays」, 126행 「Empty comments is [] only for a quiet thread」, 128행 「do not… treat every topic as a silent thread」. 지울 부분은 53토큰(실측). 「six」는 원본의 고정값 0–6 흔적이다: 지금은 댓글 수가 설정(cmt_min·cmt_max 0~20, gnet.ts:110)이라 「not capped at six」「may exceed six」는 근거가 없고, 최소를 1 이상으로 두면 「There is no per-post minimum」이 같은 문단 첫 문장 「Use __GN_CMT_RANGE__ comments」와 부딪친다. 「user-action reactions follow their separate contract」는 새로고침 요청에 없는 것을 가리킨다. 원본 작성자가 일부러 겹쳐 쓴 문장일 수 있어 사용자 결정.
also_change: gnet.txt:120 「Retained comment totals may exceed six; the initial new-post comment range is not a retention cap.」 → 「Retained comment totals may exceed the new-post comment range.」. tests/guide-out.test.mjs LATER 목록(gnet.refresh.*).

In BOARD.GUIDELINE at line 207, 'Use __GN_CMT_RANGE__ comments per new NPC post' is filled from the cmt_min/cmt_max settings (gnetPrompt.ts:53; gnet.ts COUNT_RANGE cmt [0,20]). The same paragraph then says 'There is no per-post minimum'. With the default cmt_min=0 that is true, but if the user sets a minimum of 1 or more, the two sentences conflict. 'Saved threads are not capped at six' and AUTO.GUIDELINE line 114 'Retained comment totals may exceed six' are left over from the original fixed 0-6 count; the cap is now a setting, so 'six' is stale. 'user-action reactions follow their separate contract' points to REACT.GUIDELINE, which is not in the refresh request (refreshPrompt sends LB+BOARD, AUTO, ATTACHMENTS+INCOMING). The original card (dist-test/real-module.json, GNet) has the same sentences word for word, so this is original LightBoard text that went stale when counts became settings. 'Do not leave comments empty' really is repeated about five times (BOARD 207 x2, AUTO 114, AUTO.FORMAT x2). The stale and contradicting part is a clear error. Cutting the anti-minimise sentence as well is a matter of taste on original text, so I kept it out of the main edit.

title_ko: 다른 글 활동 댓글 수가 한 문단에 두 가지 범위로 적혀 있다
old_text: Return only NEW comments: 0–__LIMIT_replies__ per post, each at most __LIMIT_comment_tokens__ tokens.
new_text: Return only NEW comments, each at most __LIMIT_comment_tokens__ tokens.
evidence: 197행에 「An updated activity post gets __GN_ACT_RANGE__ new comments」(설정 act_min~act_max)가 덧붙었는데 198행의 원래 문장 「0–__LIMIT_replies__ per post」(고급 설정 「한 번에 받을 답글 최대」)가 남아 있다. 앱이 실제로 자르는 기준은 act_max 다(ui/gnet.ts:270·321·375 가 applyActivity 에 counts.act[1] 을 넘김). 기본값은 둘 다 0-4라 같은 말을 두 번 하는 것이고, 두 설정을 다르게 두면(예: 활동 0-8, 답글 4) 서로 어긋난다. 12토큰 줄어든다.
also_change: tests/guide-out.test.mjs LATER 목록(gnet.post·gnet.comment·gnet.refreshOne).

v2.reasoning: ACTIVITY.GUIDELINE in gnet.txt says at line 191 'An updated activity post gets __GN_ACT_RANGE__ new comments' (act_min-act_max from the board settings) and at line 192 'Return only NEW comments: 0–__LIMIT_replies__ per post'. __LIMIT_replies__ is LIMITS.replies, the advanced setting 'replies' (advanced.ts 한 번에 받을 답글 최대; famtable.ts:134 describes it as the number of replies to MY post/comment). The app clips activity comments to counts.act[1]: ui/gnet.ts:275, 328 and 384 pass gnetSettings(...).counts.act[1] as the cap to applyActivity. With the defaults (act 0-4, replies 4) the two numbers only repeat each other. If the user sets act to 0-8, or replies to 2, the model gets two different ranges, and the 0–N one is not the cap the code applies.

evidence: What a B00 player's main request says: tag.txt:61-62 and :66 render as "A00 = Fake Anomaly Management Bureau / B00 = Anomaly Management Bureau" and "current affiliation: 관리국 (Code: B00)" (src/data/scenarios.json:23 affiliation "관리국"); the Faction block says members call their own organization the Management Bureau; the status example built in statuscols.ts:184-185 shows 관리국/신입. So the model writes Identity = 관리국/직급. The parser maps 관리국 to A00 and only 가짜 관리국 to B00 (src/core/people/identity.ts:5-6), host/people.ts:241-252 stores it, and userFactionOf (src/core/people/faction.ts:13-16) prefers it over $st_faction. Probe /tmp/audit_1113/gmain/r6.mjs: identity 관리국/사원 with $st_faction=B00 gives user faction A00, rank level null, and the People block line "가짜 관리국 → 김유저: Hostile. Members attack 김유저 on sight". STATUS.RULE.IDENTITY (main.txt:25) only lists both spellings as examples and cannot settle it, so the fix belongs in the reader.
also_change: src/host/people.ts:39 import: `import { parseIdentity, rankLevel } from '../core/people/identity';`. Related, not fixed by this edit: factionsBlock (src/core/people/faction.ts:44-48) labels A00 as 관리국 for every viewer, so a correctly coded B00 player reads "관리국 → user: Hostile" while the Faction block calls the player's own organization the Management Bureau; adding the code to the label (for example 관리국 [A00]) would remove that ambiguity.

v2.reasoning: I tried to disprove it and couldn't. Nothing guards against it, and it hasn't been fixed in the working tree (git diff of src/host/people.ts doesn't touch statusIdentity, and identity.ts is unchanged). A B00 player's main request tells the model the player's affiliation is '관리국' (scenarios.json:23 affiliation "관리국", rendered by tag.txt: "current affiliation: 관리국 (Code: B00)"). The always-on Faction text (faction-original.txt:63) says: "members of each Bureau call their own organization the 'Management Bureau'". The Identity rule (main.txt:25 / statuscols.ts:182) gives both `관리국/신입` and `가짜 관리국/대리` as examples, and the status example (statuscols.ts:187) uses `관리국/신입`. So a B00 model writing `관리국/사원` in character is the ordinary case. parseIdentity → factionCode('관리국') matches only the second pattern (/관리국|.../ → A00), because /가짜\s*관리국|fake/ needs 가짜. statusIdentity (host/people.ts:187) returns faction A00, and runOnce stores it as store.identity. userFactionOf (core/people/faction.ts:13-16) takes store.identity.faction ahead of $st_faction. So for every computation the user becomes A00: faction base and standings, seedBaseFor for forms of address, and relative rank. The rank level comes out null because 사원 is not on the A00 ladder. Unit tests (tests/people-identity.test.mjs:34-35) pin only '가짜 관리국/대리' → B00 and don't cover this case.
v2.proof: Ran /tmp/audit_1113/gmain/r6.mjs (bundle of the current identity/faction code) with $st_faction=B00. Identity '관리국/사원' gave user faction A00, level null, and the Factions block line "- 가짜 관리국 → 김유저: Hostile. Members attack 김유저 on sight, even outside their own ground." So the main model is told that the player's own organization attacks them on sight. Identity '가짜 관리국/사원' gave user faction B00, level 1 (correct). The people feature is on by default (core/people/settings.ts:11 on:'1').
v2.fix_plan: In src/host/people.ts, statusIdentity(): after parsing, if the parsed faction is A00 and this chat's own faction (the existing local helper userFaction(chat), host/people.ts ~line 143, which reads $st_faction and st_faction) is B00, and the identity text has no 가짜/fake, return the identity with faction 'B00' and level recomputed by rankLevel('B00', rank). Add rankLevel to the existing import from '../core/people/identity'. Do NOT change factionCode/parseIdentity/ORG_CODES in core/people/identity.ts. They are shared with updater.ts:1177/1219 and factionCodesIn, and the pinned tests expect '관리국' → A00 when there is no context. Do not change the guides either: the Identity rule examples and the Faction text are correct as they stand. Optional unit test: tests/people-identity.test.mjs (or a host test) for '관리국/사원' with $st_faction=B00 → B00, level 1.
v2.final_old_text: return t.identity ? parseIdentity(t.identity, messageKey(list[i], i)) : null;
v2.side_effects: Needs `import { parseIdentity, rankLevel } from '../core/people/identity';` in src/host/people.ts (line 39). Possible issue: a B00 player who writes 관리국/요원 (A00-style rank) gets level null under the company ladder. That is no worse than today. Known limit: a B00 player who really defects to A00 and writes plain '관리국/...' stays B00 until $st_faction changes through the [AC] tag. That is acceptable because [AC] is what changes $st_faction. No guide text changes, so tests/guide-out.test.mjs is unaffected. Run tests/people-identity.test.mjs and npm test. A related wider issue is out of scope here: factionCodesIn (scene faction detection) also maps prose '관리국' to A00 for B00 players.

title_ko: 상황판 지침이 「유지 기한이 지나면 끝내라」와 「시간이 흘렀다고 끝내지 마라」를 함께 말한다
old_text: Elapsed time alone is not a resolution.
new_text: Elapsed time alone is not a resolution unless the entry's 유지 기한 has passed.
evidence: tag.txt:5 (added 2026-11-05 at the owner's request, commit 48f022adb): "If the status time of THIS reply passes an entry's 유지 기한 ... close that entry in this reply". tag.txt:48 (original text): "Elapsed time alone is not a resolution." tag.txt:49: "While {{user}} is directly involved with an anomaly, do not end it ... merely because time has elapsed." All three sit in the same block of every main request while the world board is on. The code agrees with line 49: expire() skips the anomaly the user is exploring (src/core/world/engine.ts:379), yet reports() still prints its deadline (engine.ts:748, dueMeta with no exploring check), so for that anomaly line 5 orders a close that line 49 and the code forbid.
also_change: src/core/world/engine.ts:748: `${dueMeta(e, e.kind, s)}` -> `${e.exploring ? '' : dueMeta(e, e.kind, s)}` so the anomaly the user is inside shows no deadline, matching expire(). tag.txt:5: `{elapsed}` -> `{N시간 N분 전}`; the literal text {elapsed} is sent to the model although the real marker, named on line 46, is {N시간 N분 전}.

v2.reasoning: Confirmed. tag.txt:5 (owner request 11-05) tells the model to close any entry whose {유지 기한} the reply's time passes; tag.txt:48 (original) says 'Elapsed time alone is not a resolution'; tag.txt:49 says not to end an anomaly the user is directly involved in merely because time elapsed. The code sides with line 49 only for the explored anomaly: expire() skips e.exploring (src/core/world/engine.ts:379), and the engineer's uncommitted takeEndAt change also passes null due for exploring entries (engine.ts:562). But reports() still appends dueMeta to every active AN line with no exploring check (engine.ts:765), so for the anomaly the user is exploring the model is shown a passed deadline and told by line 5 to close it, and applyAnomalies accepts that close tag (engine.ts:559-563) - the player's ongoing exploration gets ended. Separately, line 48 literally contradicts line 5 for all other entries (a passed deadline is elapsed time).
v2.proof: Line walk: preset_expire=1, preset_ttl=6, AN entry born=10:00, applyExploration sets exploring=true (engine.ts:663), now=17:00. expire(): e.exploring -> m=null, not closed. reports(): `[AN|...]{7시간 0분 전} {유지 기한 MM.DD 16:00}` (dueMeta has no exploring guard). tag.txt:5 => model must output 상태 격리/소멸/클리어 this reply; tag.txt:49 => must not. If the model obeys line 5, applyAnomalies endAn()s it.
v2.fix_plan: 1) src/core/world/engine.ts, reports(), the AN map (line ~765): replace `${dueMeta(e, e.kind, s)}` with `${e.exploring ? '' : dueMeta(e, e.kind, s)}` so the explored anomaly shows no deadline (matches expire() at :379 and takeEndAt at :562). Do NOT touch the IN/MS lines (expire() does close those even when touched). 2) src/data/guides/tag.txt line 48: qualify the general sentence so it no longer contradicts line 5 (edit below). Do not change line 5 (owner decision 11-05) or line 49.

title_ko: 이동·임무 지시문의 지시 문장이 지난 것까지 매 요청에 통째로 다시 실린다
old_text: if (extra.length) content = withUserInput(null, content, extra.join('\n\n'));
evidence: Each 출발 / 임무 요청 is stored as a user message holding COMMON + OPENING or CONTINUATION + CONTEXT (src/core/dispatch.ts:91-94), and unwrapScenes sends that whole body again in every later request (request.ts:42-66). Probe /tmp/audit_1113/gmain/r7.mjs: a directive from three turns earlier still arrives as 154 tokens, of which only 17 are context (Subject / Companions); COMMON is 95 tokens, OPENING 46, CONTINUATION 33. So every past directive still in context costs 128-141 tokens per call (five of them is about 650), and stale orders such as "Create an opening" or "Do not relocate the protagonist" stay in history as user-role instructions. The original card behaved the same way, so this changes what the model sees of past turns.

v2.reasoning: Confirmed from the code. sceneDirective (src/core/dispatch.ts:91-94) joins COMMON + OPENING/CONTINUATION + CONTEXT with '\n\n' and fills them. The result is stored as plain text inside %%SCENE_CARD%% in a user message. unwrapScenes (src/core/request.ts:42-66) only removes the markers (stripSceneCard) and merges the Situation, and it does this for every scene card in history whether or not an assistant reply already follows it. body.ts:149 calls it on every main request. So each past 출발/임무 directive still in context re-sends COMMON (~95 tok) plus OPENING (~46) or CONTINUATION (~33), about 130-140 tokens of stale user-role orders such as 'Create an opening' or 'Do not relocate the protagonist'. Mitigations: an assistant reply always follows, so a capable model mostly treats these as already handled. The original card behaved the same way. The cost depends on how many directives sit in the context window. This is real token waste, but the edit changes what the model sees of past turns, so the owner should decide. The reporter's new_text calls dropSceneInstructions, which does not exist and must be written.

'-separated chunk of the body, which is the filled CONTEXT section (Subject:/Companions:), because sceneDirective puts CONTEXT last and CONTEXT itself only uses single newlines: `const parts = content.split(/?
?
/); if (parts.length > 1) content = parts[parts.length - 1];`. Keep the Situation/extra merging as is, so the user's own added text survives. Do NOT touch the latest unanswered directive. On a reroll the assistant reply is absent from the request, so the directive stays full. Do NOT change sceneRecord/stored chat text, directive.txt, or unwrapCalls. Add a unit test in tests/core.test.mjs next to the existing unwrapScenes tests: an answered directive yields only 'Subject: …
Companions: …' (+ Situation), and the last unanswered one stays full.

title_ko: 상태창 시각은 오전/오후 12시간제인데 종료 시각 표기는 24시간제라는 말이 없어, 따라 쓰면 종료 시각이 읽히지 않는다

evidence: The same request gives the status format "[▣|YYYY.MM.DD|HH:MM AM/PM|…]" with examples "02:47 AM", "10:15 PM" (src/core/world/statuscols.ts:23, rendered status.section). The deadline the plugin prints is 24-hour (engine.ts:699 clock → "{유지 기한 01.02 14:00}") and the parser END_AT (src/core/world/engine.ts:710) is /\(\s*종료\s*(\d{1,2})\.(\d{1,2})\s+(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})\s*\)/ — "(종료 01.02 02:30 PM)" does not match (text stays in 상황, time falls back to now) and "02:30" meant as PM is read as 02:30. gnet.txt:418 already says "the 24-hour narrative time"; tag.txt is the only place that leaves it unstated. Alternative: make END_AT accept AM/PM in code.

v2.reasoning: Confirmed. tag.txt:5 asks the model to write (종료 MM.DD HH:MM) without saying 24-hour time. The same request's status line uses 'HH:MM AM/PM' (src/core/world/statuscols.ts:23). The parser END_AT (src/core/world/engine.ts:726) matches only /\(\s*종료\s*(\d{1,2})\s*\.\s*(\d{1,2})\s+(\d{1,2})\s*:\s*(\d{2})\s*\)/ and reads the hour as 24-hour (Date.UTC at engine.ts:738). Walk-through: if the model writes '(종료 01.02 02:30 PM)', the regex fails because ' PM' comes before ')'. takeEndAt then returns the fallback time (the deadline if it has passed) and the literal '(종료 01.02 02:30 PM)' stays in the 상황 text and the report. If it writes '(종료 01.02 02:30)' meaning PM, that is read as 02:30 AM and is either rejected (before born, so fallback) or stored 12 hours early. I lowered severity to low: the model sees '{유지 기한 01.02 14:00}' deadlines, which are printed in 24-hour (engine.ts clock()), right next to the instruction, so it will usually copy 24-hour. Also, a parse failure only degrades to the documented fallback ('the system closes it at the deadline'). tag.txt has no compact/detailed twin, and the text is not in tests/fixtures/guide-out-old.json (grep for '종료 MM.DD' finds nothing there).

The finding is real. Two halves had to hold, and both do.

1. Risu re-runs the replacer on its own output. I fetched kwaroran/Risuai main `src/ts/process/request/request.ts` myself (md5 6cd5eedb…, identical to the reporter's copy). A failed attempt reaches `trys += 1; if (trys > db.requestRetrys)` (line 330-331) and loops again; the banCharacterset path does `continue` (line 304-306). `requestChatDataMain` clones `arg.formated` (line 456), so the plugin's inserted blocks survive untouched into the next pass. `requestRetrys` defaults to 2 (database.svelte.ts 201-202), so one send can run the replacer up to 3 times. Only a fallback-model switch resets to `originalFormated` (line 224).

2. The plugin's second pass is not idempotent.
- `/home/user/goei-plugin/src/body.ts` 166-172 inserts every `moduleContext()` text before the last user message with no "already there" check.
- `/home/user/goei-plugin/src/core/people/request.ts` 124-129 `insertBlock` has no check either. It is used for the people block (line 136) and the Director note (body.ts 377).
- Neither `/home/user/goei-plugin/src/main.ts` 134-143 nor the top of `onBeforeRequest` has a re-entry guard.
- `/home/user/goei-plugin/src/host/trace.ts` 148-154 `traceBegin` pushes a new turn on every pass, with `TRACE_KEEP = 5`.

Steps that are safe on a second pass: lore (`LORE_MARK`, not stripped by sanitize), status (`STATUS_HEAD`), inventory, homeshop block, and the image prompt (`stripImgLore` removes the plugin's own block before re-adding; I probed this).

Corrections to the report:
- Severity is medium, not high. It only happens when an attempt fails and Risu retries (429, 5xx, banned-charset). The content is duplicated rather than wrong, and nothing saved is lost. The cost is that the reference and people blocks are sent 2-3 times, `$gen_ctx_total` is exceeded, and the call log fills with repeat turns.
- The extra Director call only happens when the user turned `director_reuse` off; it defaults to on (`/home/user/goei-plugin/src/core/people/settings.ts` 179). The Router is always cached by key.
- The code is unchanged since v0.21.11 (`git show 782dca17c:src/body.ts` has the same lines), so this is already live in the released version.

title_ko: 괴담넷과 괴담톡을 한 번에 묻는 통합 요청에서 첨부 쓰는 법 안내문이 망가진 채 모델에 간다

**What happens**
- `prepareAttachments` skips only `role === 'system'` messages (src/core/attach.ts:173). Its own comment at 166-167 says system text holds output-format examples and must not be touched.
- The unit test in tests/attach.test.mjs:24-29 pins that intent: it asserts the system message is returned untouched (`assert.equal(out[0], sys)`).
- `combinedPrompts` (src/host/joint.ts:43-69) serialises every task's messages, including the system-role guide text, into one `role: 'user'` JSON string (line 68).
- `Joint.all()` sends that through `runModel` (joint.ts:179, and again at 192 for the envelope retry). `runModelRaw` always runs `prepareAttachments` (src/host/llm.ts:93), so the guide examples are now in a user message and get rewritten.
- The guide text is in system role when standalone: phonePrompt.ts:318 and 464, gnetPrompt.ts:111. Standalone requests are therefore fine.

**Reproduced** with a probe at /tmp/audit_1113/v-joint-attach/probe.mjs (real `Joint` plus the real guide sections, fake `risuai.runLLMModel`):
- phone `ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT` became "...inside an ordinary text/content field: [ATTACHMENT A1], or the same tag with video, file, link, gift".
- gnet `ATTACHMENTS` became "NPCs may optionally send [지원하지 않는 첨부] inside an ordinary content/body string, replacing TYPE with...".
- A third message was appended: `ATTACHMENT DATA: ... A1 {"kind":"photo","content":"what the picture shows"}`, a fake attachment record.
- The same phone messages sent alone kept the example intact.

**Why no guard saves it**
- No normalisation or later overwrite exists between `combinedPrompts` and `risuai.runLLMModel`.
- The comment at attach.ts:33 shows the authors already hit a symptom of this in joint requests and only narrowed the regex, leaving the cause.
- History records are also swapped to A-labels, so in joint mode the model sees no intact complete `[[ATTACH:kind]]...[[/ATTACH]]` example anywhere.
- The `images` check in `Joint.ask` (joint.ts:149) never fires: nothing sets `images` before `runModel`.

- Severity medium stands, but the scenario is narrower than "by default". `$net_joint` defaults on (netjoint.ts:18), but per-turn auto is off by default for phone (phone.ts:32 `auto: '0'`) and boards (gnet.ts:88 `lazy: '1'`). - The failure is degraded NPC attachment output plus one phantom attachment; no crash and no data loss.

No owner decision or guide wording is involved.

Replace attachment records per task before the tasks are merged, with shared numbering, and stop `runModel` from processing the merged request a second time.

1. **src/core/attach.ts** — add `export function prepareAttachmentGroups<T extends Msg>(groups: T[][]): { groups: T[][]; data: T | null }`.
   - Move the current body of `prepareAttachments` into it.
   - Keep ONE shared `list`/`known` across all groups so A-numbers stay global.
   - Apply the existing replace to every non-system message of every group. Return the same object when a message has nothing to replace.
   - Build the single trailing DATA message exactly as now (ATTACH.DATA head, A-lines, `IMAGE_MAX`, `images` field) and return it as `data`, or `null` when the list is empty.
   - Re-implement `prepareAttachments(messages)` as: `const r = prepareAttachmentGroups([messages]); return r.data ? [...r.groups[0], r.data] : r.groups[0];`. Its output must stay byte-identical; tests/attach.test.mjs must pass unchanged.

2. **src/host/llm.ts** — add an optional last parameter `prepared = false` to `runModel` and `runModelRaw`.
   - In `runModelRaw` use `await withPhotos(prepared ? messages : prepareAttachments(messages))`.
   - Leave every other caller untouched.

3. **src/host/joint.ts**, `Joint.all()`:
   - `const pre = prepareAttachmentGroups(kinds.map((k) => this.waits.get(k)!.messages));`
   - `const prompt = [...combinedPrompts(kinds.map((k, i) => ({ key: JOINT_KEY[k], messages: pre.groups[i] }))), ...(pre.data ? [pre.data] : [])];`
   - Call `runModel(prompt, this.model, this.staticModel, label, true)`.
   - Pass `true` on the envelope-retry call at line 192 as well, so the model's own raw output is not rewritten to A-labels.

**Must NOT change**
- `combinedPrompts` signature and output (used by tests/joint.test.mjs and tests/guide-out-calls.mjs).
- `instruction()` and all guide text.
- The fallback calls that send each task alone (`runModel(w.messages, ...)` at joint.ts:151, 169, 204), which stay unprepared so `runModel` prepares them as today.
- The system-role skip in attach.ts:173.

Side benefit: records are unescaped at one JSON level instead of two, so DATA contents no longer carry stray backslashes in joint requests.

title_ko: 「동시 요청 수」 설정이 통합 요청과 그 뒤 따로 보내기에는 적용되지 않는다
evidence: llm.ts:194 `attempt === 0 && o.first ? await o.first(ask) : await slot(o.concurrent, …)` — Joint.ask 로 가는 첫 요청은 slot 밖. joint.ts 151(혼자 보내기), 169(flush), 179(통합), 191(다시 묻기), 204(통합 뒤 따로: kinds 전부를 await 없이 동시에) 모두 runModel 직접 호출이라 $gen_concurrent 를 거치지 않는다. core/advanced.ts 의 concurrent 설명은 괴담넷·괴담톡·위키 요청을 대상으로 적혀 있다.
scenario: 동시 요청을 1로 둔 사용자(요금제 동시 제한 때문): 통합 응답을 못 갈라 따로 보내는 순간 괴담넷 4곳+괴담톡 5건이 한꺼번에 나가 429 가 나고, 각 작업의 일시 오류 재시도까지 겹친다. 설정을 지켰다고 믿는 사용자는 원인을 알 수 없다.
fix_sketch: Joint 에 concurrent 를 넘겨 151/169/204 의 runModel 을 slot() 으로 감싼다(통합 한 건 자체는 칸 1개만 차지하므로 11-09 의 교착은 재발하지 않는다).

v2.reasoning: Confirmed in the working tree. generate() (src/host/llm.ts:194) calls o.first(ask) outside slot() on attempt 0, and every Joint path in src/host/joint.ts calls runModel directly, never through slot(). The paths are: ask() after the joint has fired (175), flush() with a single waiter (193), the integrated request (214), the format re-ask (226), the second combined request (249), and alone() 'integrated then separate' (204). alone() is started without await for every missing or null part. The 동시 요청 hint (advanced.ts:65) says it limits 괴담넷·괴담톡·위키 requests, and phone.ts:390 / gnet.ts:222 pass concurrent through genSettings/retry, so a user's limit is silently skipped for exactly these auto requests. The reporter's '괴담넷 4곳+괴담톡 5건' overstates it: a Joint holds at most 5 kinds (phone, gn, gal, wpf, sm), one request each. The default is 0 (no limit), so only users who lowered the setting are affected.
v2.proof: Walk with $gen_concurrent=1, $net_joint on, auto=turn for phone+gn+gal+wpf+sm on the same model. body.ts:631 builds a Joint with 5 kinds, and each task's generate() calls first → Joint.ask → flush → all(). One integrated runModel runs outside slot (running stays 0). Suppose splitCombined finds only the phone part and gnet/gal/wpf/sm are missing: missing.length=4 and alive=1, so a second combined call goes out (still no slot). If that fails, alone() runs 4 times in a synchronous loop, giving 4 concurrent runModel calls while slot's counter is 0. A 429 on them comes back through generate's transient retry with attempt reset to 0, so o.first → Joint.ask (fired) → runModel again, still outside slot. A manual 위키/괴담넷 request made at the same time gets the slot (running 0 < 1) and runs alongside, so the limit of 1 is never enforced.
v2.fix_plan: 1) In src/host/llm.ts, export the limiter: rename or export `slot` (e.g. `export async function limited<T>(limit, run)`) with the same body. Do not change how generate() calls o.first: it must stay outside the slot so tasks that are waiting do not hold slots (the 11-09 deadlock). 2) In src/host/joint.ts, add a constructor parameter `private concurrent?: number` after kinds, and wrap each runModel call in `limited(this.concurrent, () => runModel(...))` at line 175 (ask after fired), line 193 (flush single), line 204 (alone), and lines 214/226/249 (integrated, re-ask, second combined). Each of these takes one slot for one request, and no waiter holds a slot while blocked in first, so this cannot deadlock. 3) In src/body.ts:631, pass `genSettings(now!.scriptstate).concurrent` as the new argument: `new Joint(group[0].model, group[0].fixed, group.map((t) => t.kind), genSettings(now!.scriptstate).concurrent)`, importing genSettings from core/advanced if it is not already imported. Do not change the hint text or the default of 0.
v2.side_effects: With a low limit, the integrated request and fallbacks now queue behind manual requests, so auto refresh can finish a little later. Unit tests that build a Joint with 3 args are unaffected because the new arg is optional. Run npm run typecheck + npm test.

title_ko: 호출 기록이 마지막 턴에 끝없이 쌓이고, 원문 한도를 40만 자로 올린 뒤로는 저장할 때마다 수 MB를 다시 쓴다
evidence: `let open` 은 traceBegin(148-154)에서만 바뀌고 clearTrace(130) 말고는 닫히지 않는다. traceCall(182-197)은 그 뒤의 모든 모델 호출(괴담톡 답장, 홈쇼핑, 위키, 수동 버튼, 다른 채팅 것까지)을 open 턴에 붙인다. 턴당 호출 수 상한 없음. 미출시 변경으로 TRACE_TEXT 6000→400000, TRACE_MAIN_TEXT 40000→400000(54, 56행). save(107-121)는 호출마다(300ms 묶음) 최근 5턴 전체를 JSON.stringify 해 pluginStorage 에 통째로 다시 쓴다.
scenario: 메시지 하나 보낸 뒤 괴담톡에서 한참 대화: 답장 호출 수십 건(요청·응답 각 최대 40만 자)이 한 턴에 쌓여 goei-trace 가 수십 MB 가 되고, 호출 때마다 그 전체를 다시 직렬화·저장 → 폰에서 버벅임·저장소 용량 초과 위험. 화면에서는 무관한 수동 호출이 「그 턴의 응답 뒤 호출」로 보인다.
fix_sketch: 응답 뒤 자동 작업이 끝나면(또는 일정 시간 뒤) open 을 닫아 이후 호출은 수동 턴으로 보내고, 턴당 호출 수와 전체 저장 크기에 상한을 둔다. 40만 자는 메인 요청 한 건에만 적용하는 것도 방법.

title_ko: 출동·전화 카드 바로 뒤에 프리셋의 유저 역할 글이 있으면 그 글이 사용자 입력인 것처럼 합쳐진다
evidence: unwrapScenes 57-61: 장면 카드 다음 메시지가 role 'user' 이고 카드가 없으면 무조건 `Situation:` 뒤에 붙이고 그 메시지를 건너뛴다(i++). unwrapCalls 82-86 도 같은 방식. 다음 메시지가 실제 채팅 메시지인지(프리셋의 post-history·jailbreak 블록인지) 구분하지 않는다.
scenario: 출동 직후나 전화 직후(카드가 채팅의 마지막 메시지)에 전송하고, 프리셋에 user 역할의 끝 지시문(흔한 구성)이 있는 경우: 프리셋 지시문 전체가 「Situation:\n<프리셋 글>」로 장면 카드 메시지 안에 들어가고 원래 자리에서는 사라진다. 모델은 프리셋 지시를 사용자의 상황 묘사로 읽는다.
fix_sketch: 합칠 대상을 실제 채팅 메시지로 한정한다(loadContext 의 chat.message 와 내용 대조, 또는 Risu memo 표시 확인). 대조가 안 되면 합치지 않는다.

The normal dispatch flow places the record card as the LAST chat message: markUnsent in host/unsent.ts puts it last, and the user sends with an empty box. So the next request message is whatever the preset puts after chat history. When that item has user role (jailbreak/post-everything/plain items set to user, common in Korean presets), it is swallowed into the card. Nothing checks that the next message is a real chat message. The tests (core.test.mjs:96-102, phone.test.mjs:211) only pin the intended chat-message case.

Find the index of the LAST message that has a scene card (or call). When o.cardIsLast (or o.callIsLast) is true, that last occurrence must not absorb messages[i+1]: no i++ and no extra from next. The normal dispatch flow places the record card as the LAST chat message: markUnsent in host/unsent.ts puts it last, and the user sends with an empty box. So the next request message is whatever the preset puts after chat history. When that item has user role (jailbreak/post-everything/plain items set to user, common in Korean presets), it is swallowed into the card. Nothing checks that the next message is a real chat message. The tests (core.test.mjs:96-102, phone.test.mjs:211) only pin the intended chat-message case. PROOF: Walk-through. Request = [system preset, …history…, {role:'user', content: sceneRecord(...)} (card, last chat message), {role:'user', content:'<Preset> Write 3 paragraphs in Korean…'}]. unwrapScenes reaches i = card index: tail = '' and next.role === 'user' with no scene card, so extra = ['<Preset> Write 3 paragraphs…'] and i++. The output card content is '<stripped card>

Situation:
<Preset> Write 3 paragraphs…' and the preset message is gone from its own slot. A phone call record in the same position gets '…places a phone call to …

<Preset>…', so the preset reads as what the caller says.
vfix: Only fold the next message when it really is the text the user typed after the card. 1) In src/core/request.ts, add an optional parameter to both functions: `unwrapScenes(messages, o?: { cardIsLast?: boolean })` and `unwrapCalls(messages, o?: { callIsLast?: boolean })`. Find the index of the LAST message that has a scene card (or call). When o.cardIsLast (or o.callIsLast) is true, that last occurrence must not absorb messages[i+1]: no i++ and no extra from next. With the option absent, behaviour is unchanged, so existing tests keep passing. 2) In src/body.ts, before the '지시문·전화 풀기' step (line 149), read the current chat once: charIndex/chatIndex via risuai.getCurrentCharacterIndex()/getCurrentChatIndex() and risuai.getChatFromIndex. Better, hoist the existing `loadContext()` result so the chat is not read twice. Keep traceBegin first in the liteNow branch. Compute `const last = chat.message?.at(-1); const lastData = last?.role === 'user' && typeof last.data === 'string' ? last.data : ''` and pass `{ cardIsLast: hasSceneCard(lastData) }` / `{ callIsLast: hasCall(lastData) }`. title_ko: 「장면 관련 먼저」를 켜면 장면과 무관한 예전 글·말풍선은 「먼저」가 아니라 아예 빠진다
evidence: focus 가 켜지면 queue = 최신 recent 개 + 그보다 오래된 것 중 related 인 것만(51-53). 관련 없는 옛 기록은 토큰·개수가 남아도 후보에 없다. 기본값: gnet.ts:108 focus true, recentPosts 1, recentDms 5 / phone.ts:49 focus true, contextRecent 8. 화면 칩 이름은 「장면 관련 먼저」(core/advanced.ts 90, 130)이고 개수 칸은 게시글 5·말풍선 200 으로 보인다.
scenario: 사용자가 괴담넷에 글을 3개 쓰고 다른 장면으로 넘어감: 설정에는 「넣을 게시글 5」인데 메인 모델에는 최신 1개만 간다. 괴담톡도 인물 이름이 장면에 안 나오면 최근 8개 말풍선만 간다. 사용자는 「먼저」를 순서 문제로 이해하므로 왜 모델이 예전 글을 모르는지 알 수 없다.
fix_sketch: 둘 중 하나: (a) 관련 기록을 먼저 넣고 남는 자리는 최신순으로 채운다(칩 이름과 일치), (b) 동작은 두고 칩 이름·설명을 「장면에 나온 것만(+최근 N개)」로 바꾼다. 어느 쪽인지는 사용자 결정.

v2.reasoning:
The code does what the report says. In pickRecords (src/core/focus.ts:53-58), when focus is on, the queue holds only the newest `recent` items plus older items with related=true. Unrelated older records are never candidates, even when the count and token budget have room. But this is intended and a test pins it: tests/focus.test.mjs line 19ff asserts '관련 없는 방은 최근 몇 개만' (got 박도윤 count == P.HISTORY.contextRecent), and the gnet test does the same. So the behaviour is not a bug. The only real problem is a label that does not match it.

The 괴담넷 half of the report is refuted. The 'gn' chip label '장면 관련 먼저' (src/core/advanced.ts:90) is never rendered. The board settings grid (src/ui/famtable.ts:148-149) draws ctx_focus with its own switch, labelled '장면에 나온 것만 고르기' with help '켜면 최근 글 1개와 쪽지 5통은 늘 붙이고, 나머지는 지금 장면에 이름이 나온 것만 붙여요.'. That already describes the real behaviour, and advChips there leaves out ctx_focus. advChipRow is only called for 'ph' (src/ui/phone.ts:1073) and 'nw' (src/ui/wiki.ts:618).

The 괴담톡 half holds, but only as a label mismatch. src/core/setdef/phone.ts:38 renders the chip '장면 관련 먼저' (src/core/advanced.ts:130) beside '넣을 말풍선 200'. With focus on (the default), unrelated rooms get only HISTORY.contextRecent = 8 (src/core/phone.ts:49, :1084), not up to 200. The '사용' row help ('지금 장면과 관련된 괴담톡 대화가 메인 요청에 붙어요') hints at filtering, but the chip word '먼저' suggests ordering only. So this is a visible-text mismatch on one screen, which makes it low severity.
v2.proof: Line walk with phone defaults: focus=true, recent=8, max=200. Room A (unrelated) has 30 messages; room B is related. newest = all items sorted newest first. rest = [items with i<8] + [items with i>=8 && related]. A's 22 older messages are not in rest, so they are never sent, although 30+5 < 200 and tokens may fit. tests/focus.test.mjs:27 asserts exactly this (박도윤 count == HISTORY.contextRecent), so the behaviour is intended. For gnet: src/ui/famtable.ts:149 shows '장면에 나온 것만 고르기' with an accurate help text, and no advChipRow('gn', ...) call exists in live UI, so the misleading gn chip label is never shown.
v2.fix_plan:
Keep the selection logic as it is: src/core/focus.ts pickRecords is pinned by tests/focus.test.mjs and matches the gnet help text. Change only the phone (괴담톡) visible chip label, so it says what the gnet switch already says.

In src/core/advanced.ts line 130, change the ph chip label from '장면 관련 먼저' to '장면에 나온 것만', matching the wording style of the wiki chip at line 170 ('장면에 나온 문서만') and the gnet switch. Optionally change the gn chip at line 90 to the same text for consistency. It is not rendered, but the AI 상담 catalog or future screens may read it.

Do not change focus.ts, HISTORY.contextRecent, CONTEXT.recentPosts/recentDms, or the setting keys (ctx_focus stays). Alternatively, if the owner prefers '먼저' semantics (option a), pickRecords would need a fill-up pass with unrelated older records after the related ones, and tests/focus.test.mjs lines 19-34 and the gnet focus test would have to change. Not recommended.

title_ko: 플러그인이 뒤에 끼우는 로어·참고 기록·인물 기록은 리스의 최대 컨텍스트 계산 밖이라 모델 한도를 넘길 수 있다
evidence: loreOptions 589-601: 로어 예산 = floor((tokenBudget(기본 99999) − always) × 0.9). body.ts 279-318 fixLore 가 태그·세력·명부·RP 지침·고른 로어를 한 블록으로 넣고, 이어서 참고 기록($gen_ctx_total 기본 0 = 합계 무제한)·인물 기록·상태창·소지품이 붙는다. 모두 Risu 가 채팅을 최대 컨텍스트에 맞춰 자른 뒤 beforeRequest 에서 추가되는 양이다.
scenario: 최대 컨텍스트를 모델 한도 가까이 잡은 사용자: Risu 는 한도에 맞췄다고 보지만 실제 전송은 플러그인 추가분(수천~수만 토큰)만큼 커져 모델이 길이 초과로 거절하거나 앞부분을 잘라낸다. 원인이 화면에 드러나지 않는다.
fix_sketch: 호출 기록(traceMain)에 「플러그인이 더한 토큰」을 보여 주고, 합계가 Risu 최대 컨텍스트를 넘으면 경고하거나 참고 기록부터 줄인다. 기본 상한을 둘지는 사용자 결정.

All of this runs after Risu has already trimmed chat history to its max context, so Risu never counts it. storeLore's own comment says the slot design existed so that 'Risu가 세고 넘치면 오래된 채팅을 지운다'. The slotless path lost that, and nothing in the plugin compares the final size with chat maxContext (grep: maxContext appears only in cbs.ts). loreOptions caps lore only by the lorebook tokenBudget (default 99999), not by the context size. The code path is real. It only bites users whose Risu max context sits close to the model's hard limit, so severity is low. Any fix (warning, auto-trim, cap) is a design choice.
v2.fix_plan: Minimal and non-design: in src/body.ts onBeforeRequest, after the last step ('이미지 지침'), add up the tokens of the system blocks the plugin inserted (tokens() from core/gnet) and record them in the 호출 기록 trace (src/host/trace.ts, e.g. an 'added' field shown next to totalTokens). If the owner wants enforcement: read the chat's maxContext (db/preset via risuai) and, when request tokens exceed it, drop 참고 기록 blocks first (moduleContext output), oldest first. title_ko: 전송이 실패하면 「다음 메시지에 사용」으로 담아 둔 물건 칩이 최대 3분 동안 사라져 보인다
evidence: markUseSent(62-68, body.ts:179 에서 [Inventory] 삽입 직후 호출)는 요청이 나가는 순간 칩을 숨긴다. 되살리는 길은 onWaiting 의 late(71-76)뿐인데, late 는 host/waiting.ts 의 180초 타이머가 끝나야 온다. 요청 실패를 바로 알려 주는 신호는 쓰지 않는다. 물건은 변수에 그대로 남아 다음 전송에 다시 실린다.
scenario: 물건 2개를 「사용」에 담고 전송 → 모델 오류로 몇 초 만에 실패. 상자가 비어 보여 사용자가 물건을 다시 담으려 하거나(이미 대기 중이라 혼란), 바로 재전송하면 화면에 안 보이는 사용이 그대로 실려 나간다. 3분 뒤에야 칩이 돌아온다.
fix_sketch: Risu 가 전송을 끝냈는데 새 응답이 없을 때(doingChat 해제·채팅 길이 그대로) 바로 되살리거나, 숨기는 대신 「보내는 중」 표시로 바꿔 output 훅에서 확정한다.

v2.reasoning: Unreleased change. markUseSent (usebox.ts:62-68, called at body.ts:187 in beforeRequest) sets `sent` and hides the chips. `sent` is cleared only when (a) sentUseIds sees ITEM_USE_AT_VAR set (the response was settled) or lastUserKey changes, or (b) onWaiting fires with late=true (usebox.ts:71-76). waiting.ts:10 fires late only after the 180_000 ms timer. onOutput calls setWaiting(false) without late, which is correct for success. A failed or aborted request triggers no plugin hook (no failure signal in src/host; grep found no doingChat/abort API), and Risu keeps the user message, so lastUserKey is unchanged. The chips therefore stay hidden for up to 3 minutes, even across chat switches (refreshUseBox keeps filtering by sent for that chat). The items still sit in the variable and go out with the next send, so no data is lost. Only the box shows empty and misleads the user.
v2.fix_plan: Two acceptable options, both in src/host/usebox.ts (owner picks). (A, no UI text change) Keep hiding but drop the hide sooner: in the existing 2-second snapshot tick in src/body.ts (the loop around line 860 that already calls refreshUseBox), if usebox's `sent` is set for this chat and isWaiting() is true but the chat's last message is still that user message and Risu is not streaming (no new char message within N seconds; there is no host signal, so this stays heuristic), clear it. Simpler: lower the late timer for usebox only, e.g. a usebox-local timer of ~30–60 s started in markUseSent that clears `sent` and calls refreshUseBox. Do NOT change waiting.ts's 180 s (people.ts/homeshop.ts depend on it). (B) Instead of hiding, keep the chips shown with the label changed to 「보내는 중」 while `sent` is set (useBoxCss label ::before content), so a failure leaves them visible. This changes visible text.

evidence: guideInput('ed-guide-sec')은 칸을 순번으로만 찾는다: `const parts = splitGuide(guideUi.draft[name] ?? guideText(name)); if (!parts[i]) return true; parts[i] = { ...parts[i], body: value }; guideUi.draft[name] = joinGuide(parts);`. 제목(##/###)으로 나누는 지침(RP·Tag·Updater·UpdaterCompact)은 본문에 '## '이나 '### '으로 시작하는 줄이 들어가면 다음 입력 때 절 수가 바뀌는데 화면 칸의 순번(data-key="이름|i")은 그대로다. /tmp/audit_1113/guides/sim1.mjs: RP에서 한 칸에 '### My rule' 줄을 넣고 계속 치면 절이 8개에서 27개로 늘고 같은 제목이 반복해 쌓임(7,549자, 기대 7,305자). sim2.mjs: 그 뒤 아래 칸에 '!' 한 글자를 치면 2,086자짜리 'Knowledge and Disclosure' 절 본문이 '!'로 바뀜.
scenario: 사용자가 RP 지침의 한 절 안에 소제목(### …)을 붙여 넣거나 직접 친 뒤 계속 입력한다. 0.7초 뒤 자동 저장(src/ui/editor/index.ts:265-271)되고, 망가진 지침이 그대로 메인 요청에 들어간다(src/body.ts:314). 다른 절이 통째로 사라져도 화면에는 경고가 없다.
fix_sketch: 입력 때마다 화면에 있는 모든 칸의 값을 모아 지침을 다시 짓거나, 절 수가 바뀌면 그 자리에서 화면을 다시 그린다. 또는 제목으로 나누는 지침은 본문 안의 '##' 줄을 절 경계로 보지 않도록 처음 나눈 경계를 고정한다.

v2.reasoning: src/ui/editor/guides.ts guideInput('ed-guide-sec') (lines ~91-100) re-splits the whole guide text with splitGuide() on every keystroke and writes the textarea value into parts[i] by position. The textareas' data-key "name|i" come from the split done in guidePage when the page was drawn. For guides split on headings (splitGuide, src/core/guides.ts:277, /^#{2,3} ([^\n]*)\n/gm, used when there is no @@SECTION and no ===X=== line: RP, Tag, Updater, UpdaterCompact and others), a body line starting with '## ' or '### ' becomes a new section boundary as soon as it is joined back. From the next keystroke on, parts[i] covers only the text before the new heading, but the textarea still holds the whole old body including the heading. So the heading and the text after it are written again on every keystroke, and every textarea below is off by one index. Nothing re-renders between keystrokes: touched() only syncs token counts, and the auto-save in index.ts:265-271 calls render() only when guideUi.info is set, which it is not on a normal save. guideAction then saves the broken text as the override (deleting the draft does not help, because guideText returns the same broken override), and guidePrompt sends it to the main request. No guard, no normalisation, no test pins guideInput (tests/guide-split.test.mjs and guide-out.test.mjs do not call it). Not fixed after 1a6828bd7: the only later change to src/core/guides.ts is the SALMON_TOPICS text, and src/ui/editor/guides.ts is unchanged. Severity is medium, not high: it only happens when a user types or pastes a ##/### line inside a section, which is plausible because the default RP text itself uses ##/### headings. When it does happen it silently corrupts the saved guide.
v2.proof: Ran /tmp/audit_1113/guides/sim1.mjs and sim2.mjs. Both bundle the current src/core/guides.ts and copy the guideInput logic line by line. sim1: typed '\n### My rule\n- be brief' one character at a time at the end of RP section 1 ('Play Principles'). Sections went from 8 to 27, and 'My rule' variants piled up ('My rule' x12, 'My rul', 'My ru', … 'M', ''). The draft grew to 7549 chars against an expected 7305 (default 7282 + 23). sim2: after that, typing '!' in the textarea drawn as the next section replaced the 2086-char 'Knowledge and Disclosure' body with '!' (body len=1; the original body is gone).
v2.fix_plan: In src/ui/editor/guides.ts, stop re-splitting the guide while the user types. Keep the section layout that is on screen. (1) Add a cache to guideUi, e.g. `parts: {} as Partial<Record<GuideName, GuidePart[]>>` (import type GuidePart from core/guides, or use ReturnType<typeof splitGuide>). (2) In guidePage, after `const parts = splitGuide(text);`, store `guideUi.parts[name] = parts.map((p) => ({ ...p }))`, so every render resets the cache to match the drawn data-key indices. (3) In guideInput, for both 'ed-guide-sec' and 'ed-guide-title', use `const parts = guideUi.parts[name] ?? splitGuide(guideUi.draft[name] ?? guideText(name));`, change parts[i] in place (body, or title/head for the title input), then set `guideUi.parts[name] = parts` and `guideUi.draft[name] = joinGuide(parts)`. Keep the existing `if (!parts[i]) return true` and `if (!md) return true` guards. A heading typed inside a body then stays in that section's body until the next render, which re-splits it into its own section with the indices redrawn, so nothing is duplicated or lost. Must NOT change: splitGuide/joinGuide in src/core/guides.ts (also used by guidePrompt for user rules), the save path in guideAction, the auto-save timing in index.ts, or the visible page. Optional extra: if the joined text re-splits to a different section count, call render() after the debounced save so the new heading shows as its own section. Not required for correctness.
v2.side_effects: No guide text changes, no visible UI change. No unit test pins guideInput. Run tests/guide-split.test.mjs and tests/guide-out.test.mjs after the change. tests/qc-static-cache-browser.mjs mentions the guide editor, but it is a browser test and is not run under the current test rules unless this screen is released. Guides split by @@SECTION or ===X=== have the same position-based write, but a boundary there needs a literal '@@END' or '===X===' line in a body, which is rare. The cache fix covers those too.

evidence: talkPrompt가 `SHELF_RULES(g, s, st)`를 guide 인자 없이 부르고(기본값 'Shop'), 952행에서 `v = { line: SHOP_LINE }`로 8칸 줄 꼴을 넣는다. 반면 진열 요청(shelfPrompt)은 guide를 넘겨 Cos일 때 9번째 '진실' 칸과 SHELF_SECRET 절을 넣는다. /tmp/audit_1113/guides/costalk.mjs 결과: Cos 문의 시스템 글에 '구분|진실' 줄 꼴 없음(false), SHELF_SECRET 글 없음(false). 같은 요청에 보여 주는 진열 목록에는 9번째 칸과 SECRET_NOTE가 들어 있다. Cos 진열 요청에는 '구분|진실'이 있다(true).
scenario: 우주 쇼핑몰(Cos)에서 상인에게 말을 걸어 물건이 새로 들어오거나 다시 채워지면, 모델은 8칸 꼴로만 답하라는 지시를 받아 '진실' 칸을 쓰지 않는다. 그 물건은 설명과 실제 효과가 다른 숨은 효과 장치가 빠진 채 진열된다.
fix_sketch: talkPrompt에 guide를 받아 SHELF_RULES(g, s, st, guide, truthMode)와 그 몰의 줄 꼴(lineOf(guide))을 넘긴다. src/ui/malls.ts 367·510행의 호출도 Cos를 넘기게 한다.

title_ko: 새로 옮긴 95개 절은 비워도 옛 글이 그대로 보내진다 (화면은 비어 있고 0토큰)
evidence: guideSec: `return c.secs[section]?.trim() || null;` → 빈 절도 null. guideOr(355-359행): `if (t === null) return typeof fallback === 'function' ? fallback() : fallback;` → 코드에 남은 옛 글을 보낸다. 같은 꼴이 src/core/gnetPrompt.ts:78(orOld)과 src/core/hslog.ts:147에도 있다. tests/guide-out.test.mjs에 '비운 절은 없는 것으로'라는 단언이 있어 의도한 동작이지만, 예전부터 있던 절(fillGuide(g.X)로 읽는 것)은 비우면 정말로 빠진다.
scenario: 사용자가 요청 공통(Common)이나 갱신기 덧붙임(UpdaterExtra)의 한 절을 지워서 그 지시를 끄려 한다. 편집 화면에는 빈 칸과 줄어든 토큰 수가 보이지만 요청에는 코드 안의 옛 글이 그대로 들어간다. 옛 절과 새 절이 비웠을 때 다르게 동작한다는 표시도 없다.
fix_sketch: 절이 아예 없을 때(옛 저장본)만 기본 글을 쓰고, 절이 있는데 비어 있으면 빈 글로 보낸다. 빈 글이면 요청이 깨지는 절(출력 꼴 등)은 화면에 '비우면 기본 글이 쓰여요'라고 적는다.

v2.reasoning: src/core/guides.ts:349 guideSec returns `c.secs[section]?.trim() || null`, and guideOr (355-359) falls back to the hardcoded old text when it gets null. So blanking one of the 95 moved sections in the editor brings the code text back, while blanking an older section read with fillGuide(g.X) really drops it (e.g. shelfPrompt's `.filter(Boolean)`). The editor (src/ui/editor/guides.ts guidePage) shows the empty textarea with no token count for that section and a lower total token count, and nothing says the default text is still sent. tests/guide-out.test.mjs:93-97 pins this on purpose ('비운 절은 없는 것으로'). That test was written by an earlier Claude, not decided by the owner, and the comment above guideSec says the fallback is meant only for a missing section ('절이 없으면'). The behaviour is internally inconsistent and the editor misleads, but the outcome is benign: the default text is sent, which is what the user saw before editing. It is not a crash or a data loss, so the severity is low, not medium. Some of these sections are output formats (e.g. Common RETRY.*, OUTPUT contracts), where sending nothing would break the request, so the fallback is partly protective. Changing it is a product choice.
v2.fix_plan: Option A (recommended, smallest): leave the fallback as it is. In src/ui/editor/guides.ts guidePage, when a section's body is blank and the guide is one whose sections are read through guideOr (Common, Main, UpdaterExtra, Asset, Shop/Cos/Bm moved sections, GNet family, Phone, Director moved sections), show a short note on that field, e.g. '비우면 기본 글이 쓰여요'. Option B: in src/core/guides.ts guideSec, return '' (not null) when the section header exists but the body is blank, and null only when the header is missing. guideOr then sends '' for a blanked section. Update tests/guide-out.test.mjs:93-97 accordingly. Option B must not apply to sections whose emptiness breaks parsing (output contracts); those would need a per-section allowlist. Do not change the missing-section fallback in either option.

title_ko: 상점·우주 쇼핑몰·암시장 지침 화면에 그 지침에서는 읽지 않는 절이 많이 보인다
evidence: mallGuide(77-79행)는 shop.txt에서 COMMON만 바꾸고 MAIN_TAG만 뺀 채 Cos·Bm 지침을 만든다. 그런데 읽는 쪽은 지침마다 다르다. src/core/shop.ts 979-995행(whereLine·shopRule·shopJudgeGuide·ownShopsLine·shopGuide)은 늘 'Shop'만 읽고, 889행의 SHELF_SECRET·TRUTH_*는 Cos일 때만, src/core/malls.ts 193-199행 ASSIGN_*은 Cos·Bm만, 문의(talk)는 Shop·Cos만(src/ui/malls.ts 367·510) 쓴다. 결과: Cos 화면에서 안 읽는 절 = SHOP_RULE·OWN_SHOPS·SHOP_JUDGE·WHERE_ANY·WHERE_SHOP. Shop 화면에서 안 읽는 절 = SHELF_SECRET·INFO·ORDER·TALK_OUTPUT_ORDER·TALK_OUTPUT_INFO·TRUTH_ALL/MIX/NONE·SECRET_NOTE·ASSIGN_ROLE_USEFUL/BROAD·ASSIGN_RULE. Bm 화면은 TALK*·KICK*·SELL·INFO·ORDER 등 약 26개.
scenario: 사용자가 암시장(Bm) 지침의 '문의' 절이나 우주 쇼핑몰 지침의 '상점 판단' 절을 고쳐도 어떤 요청도 달라지지 않는다. 고친 글은 저장되고 토큰 수에도 잡히지만 실제로는 쓰이지 않는다.

Bm never reaches talkPrompt: malls.ts mall-say sends bm to deskRun/bmdesk (line 524-531), and the shop talk path is gated to site==='cos' (line 533). So Bm's TALK, TALK_FEATURE, TALK_PLAIN, KICK_ON/OFF, SELL, TALK_OUTPUT*, INFO, ORDER, THOUGHTS_TALK, THOUGHTS_SELL and SECRET_NOTE are dead. The impact is limited to users who edit those particular sections, so the severity is low.

So either keep them in shop.txt and strip them from DEFAULTS.Shop with the same helper, or leave Shop as is and add a line to HELP.Shop saying which sections are mall-only. title_ko: 절 하나만 고쳐도 지침 전체가 저장되어, 이후 기본 지침의 다른 절 변경이 적용되지 않는다
evidence: guideAction('ed-guide-save')은 `setGuideOverride(name, isDefault ? '' : text)`와 `guides[name] = text`로 지침 글 전체를 기기 설정에 넣는다. 읽을 때는 `guideText = overrides.get(name) ?? DEFAULTS[name]`(src/core/guides.ts:226)이라 한 글자라도 고친 지침은 통째로 옛 글이 된다. 새로 생긴 절만 guideOr의 대체 글로 채워진다. 미출시분에서 shop.txt SHELF의 소모N/장비 표기, phone·gnet 글이 바뀌었다.
scenario: 상점 지침의 한 절만 고쳐 둔 사용자는 이번 판에서 바뀐 SHELF 줄 꼴(소모N/장비) 같은 다른 절의 새 글을 받지 못한다. 코드가 새 꼴을 기대하는데 지침은 옛 꼴을 시키게 되고, 사용자는 그 사실을 알 수 없다.
fix_sketch: 고친 절만 저장하고(절 이름 → 글) 나머지는 그때그때 기본 글에서 읽는다. 그게 어렵다면 편집 화면에 '기본 글이 바뀐 절'을 표시한다.

v2.reasoning: The mechanics are as described: guideAction stores the whole guide text in prefs, and guideText = overrides.get(name) ?? DEFAULTS[name]. This has been the design since the editor was introduced. The code knowingly handles stale overrides: guideOr falls back when a section is missing, phonePrompt.ts:130 dropSitePicGuide strips an old __SITE_PICS__ line, and guide-out.test.mjs test 3 covers 'saved with old text'. The reporter's concrete example does not break anything. The SHELF change between 782dca17c and HEAD only clarifies the meaning of 장비 and 소모N and the weight precision. The column format (`{line}`, 소모N syntax) is unchanged, so the code does not 'expect a new format' that an old override fails to produce. What remains is 'users who edited a guide earlier do not get newer default wording'. That is compatibility with previously saved user data, which the owner said not to worry about, and fixing it means redesigning storage to per-section overrides. It is not a code defect with a failure path.
v2.fix_plan: No fix required. If the owner wants it later, there is a cheap mitigation that does not redesign storage. In src/ui/editor/guides.ts guidePage, compare each section of the override with the same-named section of guideDefault(name) and the default from the release when it was saved. Mark sections whose default changed since, e.g. a small '기본 글이 바뀜' badge with a per-section reset. Per-section storage would be a larger redesign of prefs.guides and setGuideOverride.
v2.side_effects: None, since no change is proposed.

title_ko: 지침 칸에 글자를 칠 때마다 지침 전체를 다시 토큰 계산해 큰 지침에서 입력이 버벅인다
evidence: 입력마다 src/ui/editor/index.ts:392 touched() → guideBarSync(70-75행)가 지침 글 전체를 tokens()로 센다(src/core/tokenizer.ts:44-56, 글 전체가 캐시 키). 측정(/tmp/audit_1113/guides/tok.mjs, 서버 CPU): 갱신기 상세 지침(109,878자, 24,549토큰) 한 번에 47~63ms, 인터넷 지침 약 25ms. 캐시는 전체 글을 키로 최대 400개까지 쥐고 있어(CACHE_MAX 400) 큰 지침을 오래 고치면 최악 약 88MB.
scenario: 갱신기 지침을 휴대폰에서 고치면 글자마다 수십~수백 ms씩 화면이 멈춘다. 한참 입력하면 메모리도 계속 는다.
fix_sketch: 토큰 표시는 입력이 멈춘 뒤에 갱신한다(예: 300ms 뒤). 절별로 세어 더하고, 큰 글은 캐시에 넣지 않는다.

v2.reasoning: Traced at HEAD 8a17178b2 with a clean working tree, so it is not fixed yet. Every keystroke in a guide section textarea goes through src/ui/editor/index.ts:265 guideInput() and then touched() (index.ts:389). touched() calls guideBarSync() at index.ts:393 synchronously, with no debounce. guideBarSync (src/ui/editor/guides.ts:70-75) runs tokens(text) on the whole joined guide. With the o200k tokenizer loaded, tokens() calls exactTokens (src/core/tokenizer.ts:44-56). Its cache is keyed by the full text, and the text changes on every keystroke, so it always misses and does a full BPE encode. The tokenizer is part of the normal install flow (src/ui/editor/install.ts:164 installTokenizer, loaded at start by host/install.ts:223), so ordinary users have it. The updater detailed guide is 111,575 bytes (src/data/guides/updater-detailed.txt). Every miss also stores a new ~110k-char key in the cache, up to CACHE_MAX=400 entries, which comes to about 88MB of UTF-16 strings in the worst case. Autosave is debounced (later()), but the token count is not.
v2.proof: Ran /tmp/audit_1113/guides/tok.mjs (js-tiktoken o200k_base, the same Tiktoken lite class the plugin uses). updater-detailed (110,010 chars, 24,586 tokens) took 66/51/53/48/47 ms per encode, each run with a different suffix to mimic keystrokes. gnet guide (49k chars) took 21-25 ms. That is server CPU; a phone is typically several times slower. Walk: type 'a' in an Updater section -> guideInput rebuilds the draft with one more char -> touched() -> guideBarSync -> tokens(110k-char new string) -> cache miss -> encode ~50ms+ on the UI thread -> cache.set(new 110k key). Repeat for every character.
v2.fix_plan: 1) src/ui/editor/index.ts touched(): stop calling guideBarSync synchronously. Replace line 393 with a debounced call through the existing later() helper, e.g. `if (root && isGuideNode(edUi.node)) { const n = edUi.node.slice(6); later('guide-tok', () => { if (root && edUi.node === `guide:${n}`) guideBarSync(root, n); }, 300); }`. later() keys by name and clears the old timer. The head count then refreshes 300ms after typing stops. 2) src/core/tokenizer.ts exactTokens(): do not put very long strings in the 400-entry Map. For s.length > 20000, keep a single `big` slot ({s, n}) that is replaced on each miss, so memory stays bounded at one large string. Keep the Map for short strings. Must NOT change: the token numbers shown, the guidePage render output, the autosave debounce (later(`guide:${g}`)), and the record-page token update in touched().
v2.side_effects: No guide text changes. No unit test pins the per-keystroke timing. tests/guide-out*.test.mjs are unaffected. If anything checks .gw-tokens right after an input event (browser tests only), it would need to wait 300ms; browser tests are not to be run except for changed screens before release.

title_ko: 모델에게 보내는 지시 문장이 아직 코드에 박혀 있는 곳이 남아 있다
evidence: 지침으로 옮기지 않은 지시 문장: src/core/people/inject.ts:109('…it never grants closeness by itself.'), :189('## Scene rhythm (kept by the system; guidance, not content to narrate)', 'Hook clock (… never say turn numbers in the story):'), src/core/people/rhythm.ts:112('do not use the same anticipation method in consecutive turns.'), src/core/imgprompt.ts:106('- Do not create tags for {{user}}.' — 보조 모델 쪽 같은 문장은 asset.txt NO_TAG_USER로 옮겨져 있음), src/core/gnetPrompt.ts:82·304, src/core/shop.ts:908-910·969(재료 표기 안내), src/core/bmdesk.ts:178, src/core/people/updater.ts:382.
scenario: 사용자가 지침 편집 화면에서 볼 수도 고칠 수도 없는 문장이 메인 요청과 갱신기·상점 요청에 들어간다. 이번에 95개를 옮긴 작업에서 빠진 것들이다.
fix_sketch: 각 문장을 해당 지침의 절로 옮기고 guideOr로 읽는다(예: Main에 RHYTHM_HEAD·HOOK_CLOCK, Image에 NO_TAG_USER, Shop에 MATERIAL_NOTE).

v2.reasoning: All quoted sentences exist at HEAD 8a17178b2, and the working tree is clean. Most are model-facing instruction sentences built in code, so under the owner rule they count as 'hardcode' findings. 1) src/core/people/inject.ts:109: 'A separate axis from the relationship above; it never grants closeness by itself.' The same applies to inject.ts:114: 'Applies only inside intimate contexts that actually arise; an explicit current condition or the other participant's choice takes priority.' Both go to the main request in the people block. 2) inject.ts:189 rhythmBlock: '## Scene rhythm (kept by the system; guidance, not content to narrate)' and 'Hook clock (counted by the system; never say turn numbers in the story):', also sent to the main request. 3) src/core/people/rhythm.ts:122: 'do not use the same anticipation method in consecutive turns.' 4) src/core/imgprompt.ts:106: '- Do not create tags for {{user}}.' The template is user-editable, but this sentence is not; the helper-model twin is already a guide section (asset.txt NO_TAG_USER, read at core/asset.ts:124). 5) gnetPrompt.ts:304: '[not retained; do not attribute to the contact]'. 6) shop.ts:908-910 and 969, and bmdesk.ts:178: material headers with instruction tails such as '칸마다 그대로 따를 것', '다시 견적 내지 말 것', '다시 내밀지 말 것', '겹치지 말 것'. Two of the reporter's items are weaker. gnetPrompt.ts:82 IMPORTANT is used only through orOld() when the IMPORTANT_NOTE guide section is empty, and the section exists at gnet.txt:403. updater.ts:382 '## User rules (... cannot change the output contract)' is used only when the user removed <<USER_RULES>> from their guide; both default updater guides contain it. title_ko: 기본 상점에 머무는 동안 지난 대화와 판매가 매 턴 「이번 턴에 한 일」로 다시 넘어간다
evidence: shopEvents (shop.ts 837-854) pushes `just sold …` for every entry of st.sales and `talked with the owner of … — ` for all of st.talk, with no per-turn filter. settleShop line 451 keeps the whole state when the next response carries the same shop tag: `next = cur && cur.shop === tag.shop ? { ...cur, key, owner: tag.owner || cur.owner } : emptyShop(tag, key);`. Regular-shop talk lines are never stamped (src/ui/shop.ts shop-say uses sayToOwner only; stampLastLine is not imported there) and ShopSale has no key (closeSale line 807), while malls filter by `l.k === key` (malls.ts 265-266). Probe /tmp/audit_1113/mainreach/probe1.ts: after talk+sale on response c1, a second response c2 with the same `[shop: 철물점|박씨]` and no user action still returns both events: ['just sold 낡은 손전등 (14,000 won) to the owner of 철물점', 'talked with the owner of 철물점 — protagonist: "이 손전등 얼마에 사요?" / owner: "만사천 원 쳐 주지."'].
scenario: 철물점에서 주인과 흥정하고 손전등을 판 뒤, 가게 안에서 이야기를 두세 턴 더 이어 간다(응답마다 같은 상점 표식). 매 메인 요청의 [Shop] 「This turn:」에 처음 한 판매와 대화 전체가 방금 한 일처럼 다시 실려, 모델이 같은 판매·흥정을 또 서술하거나 돈을 또 받은 것처럼 쓴다.
fix_sketch: 대화 줄과 판매 기록에 그때의 마지막 응답 키를 적고(ui/shop.ts에서 stampLastLine, ShopSale에 key 추가) shopEvents에서 `=== lastBot key`인 것만 넘긴다. 쇼핑몰(mallEvents)과 같은 방식.

v2.reasoning: I tried to refute it and could not. Nothing in the regular-shop path limits shopEvents to one turn. When the next response carries the same shop tag, settleShop (src/core/shop.ts:451) keeps the whole state and only changes key to the new response: `{ ...cur, key, owner }`. The shop guide (src/data/guides/shop.txt:167) tells the model to add the tag whenever 'there is a shop right now', so the tag stays on every turn the protagonist remains inside. currentShop then matches (st.key === lastBot.key), and shopEvents (shop.ts:837-853) pushes every entry of st.sales as `just sold …` plus the whole visit's talk as `talked with the owner …`, with no per-turn filter. Neither ShopSale (shop.ts:294) nor the regular-shop talk lines carry a turn key. closeSale (807) stores only {name, price}. ui/shop.ts shop-say (574) uses sayToOwner without stampLastLine, and ask() (~387) appends the owner line through applyTalk without stamping. Malls do this correctly: ui/malls.ts stamps lines with stampLastLine, and mallEvents keeps only `l.k === key`. soldNow in items.ts deliberately skips the open shop because 'shopEvents 가 따로 넘기므로', so the open shop's sales are reported only by shopEvents. The author's comment at shop.ts:849 says the event should pass '그 턴 한 번만', so the repetition is not intended. The tests only check single-turn output (shop.test.mjs:133, shopctx.test.mjs scene), so nothing in them requires the repeat. The closed (refused-service) event repeats the same way while the tag stays.
v2.proof: Probe /tmp/audit_1113/verify2/mainreach1/probe.mjs, using shop.ts bundled with the repo's esbuild. Turn 1: response c1 carries [shop: 철물점|박씨]; then sayToOwner, an owner reply, sell price 14000, and closeSale. shopEvents returns ['just sold 낡은 손전등 (14,000 won) to the owner of 철물점', 'talked with the owner of 철물점 — protagonist: "이 손전등 얼마에 사요?" / owner: "만사천 원 쳐 주지."']. Turn 2: the user says only '가게를 둘러본다'; response c2 carries the same tag; settleShop(c2) is applied; the next user message is appended. shopEvents returns exactly the same two events. Both go into the main request's 「This turn:」, and INVENTORY_NOTE says 'when "This turn" lists an event, handle it in this response'.
v2.fix_plan:
Give regular-shop sales and talk lines a turn key, and pass to the main request only what happened after the current last response, the same way mallEvents works.
1) src/core/shop.ts: add `k?: string` to interface ShopSale. Change closeSale(st) to closeSale(st, key = '') and push `{ name, price, ...(key ? { k: key } : {}) }`. readShop's sales filter already keeps the object as is; make sure k survives (string check optional).
2) src/ui/shop.ts saleDone: call closeSale(now, now.key).
3) src/ui/shop.ts shop-say: `const next = stampLastLine(sayToOwner(st, text), st.key)`, and import stampLastLine. In ask(), inside updateChat, stamp the owner line(s) added by applyTalk with now.key before shopVars, e.g. `const stamped = stampLastLine(next, now.key)` when next.talk grew. Because the UI keeps key = now.key, st.key always equals the lastBot key that currentShop checks.
4) src/core/shop.ts shopEvents: `const key = st.key;` `const sales = st.sales.filter((x) => x.k === key);` `const turn = st.talk.filter((l) => l.k === key);` Compute lastOwner and spoke from `turn`. The 'just sold' line uses `sales`. The talk line uses capLines(turn, …). Report closed only when this turn has an owner line (`st.closed && turn.some((l) => l.who === 'owner')`).
Do NOT change: the shop model's own prompts (talkPrompt/shelfPrompt keep sending the whole visit's 「이번 방문 대화」, as the owner wanted on 11-07); settleShop's 'same shop keeps state' behaviour; soldNow's skipPlace; mallEvents.
Tests to update: tests/shop.test.mjs:133 (build `done` with closeSale(st, the c1 key) and stamp the talk), and tests/shopctx.test.mjs scene() line ~20 (give sales/talk `k: 'c1'`, or use messageKey's actual c1 key). Then run `node --test tests/shop.test.mjs tests/shopctx.test.mjs`.
v2.side_effects: Sales and talk without k (old saves) stop being reported; this is fine because old saves are not a concern. Tests that pin these values: tests/shop.test.mjs (just sold, refused service) and tests/shopctx.test.mjs (scene, 기본 상점 문의). tests/shopctx-browser.mjs and shop-judge-browser.mjs build shop state too and may need k (another process has them modified in the working tree right now). No guide or visible UI text changes.

title_ko: 망상홈쇼핑 시청 기록이 본 턴만이 아니라 다음 편성까지 매 턴 계속 붙고 언제 본 것인지 표시가 없다
evidence: `export const hsMainOn = (vars: Vars): boolean => !!vars?.[HS_LOG_VAR] && hsMainSettings(vars).on && hsMainSettings(vars).kinds.length > 0;` and body.ts 427 `if (wantHs) parts.push({ cap: hsMainSettings(ss).tokens, build: … hsMainContext(…) })` run on every main request. Log entries (kinds show/chat/say/buy) carry no turn or message key; appendLog only replaces the log when the program key/pid changes (up to 400 lines, default cap 3000 tokens). The shop grid help text (famtable.ts 249) says 「켜면 그 상점에서 한 일을 다음 메인 요청에 한 번 붙여요」 and this row was added for 망상홈쇼핑 too.
scenario: 방송을 한 번 보고 채팅 몇 줄을 친 뒤 창을 닫고 이야기를 30턴 진행한다. 매 요청에 같은 시청 기록(최대 3000토큰)이 계속 붙고, 모델은 그것이 방금 본 것인지 한참 전 일인지 알 수 없다. 응답을 다시 굴리거나 지워도 채팅 기록은 남는다. 설정 설명의 「한 번」과 실제가 다르다.
fix_sketch: 기록 줄에 본 때의 마지막 응답 키를 적어 「이번 턴에 본 것」과 「전에 본 것」을 나눠 넘기거나, 본 뒤 N턴까지만 넘기는 값을 둔다. 어느 쪽이든 설명 글을 실제와 맞춘다.

v2.reasoning: Only part of this holds up. Keeping the watch log across turns is intended: hslog.ts says one program's log is kept until a new program replaces it, it works like the other reference-record features (gnet/phone/wiki), and the owner-approved MAIN_CONTEXT header (guides.ts HS_MAIN / hslog HS_MAIN_FALLBACK) tells the model 'Continue the latest main scene; do not automatically act on anything quoted here'. Changing that is a design decision, not a bug. What is factually wrong is the visible help text. The shop table foot (src/ui/famtable.ts:249) says 「켜면 그 상점에서 한 일을 다음 메인 요청에 한 번 붙여요」, and since 11-13 the same table also has the 망상홈쇼핑 row (lines 232-245). For the other shops that is true: shopEvents/mallEvents are tied to lastBotKey, so they go to one request. For 망상홈쇼핑, hsMainOn (hslog.ts:144) only checks that $hs_log is non-empty and the settings are on, and body.ts:445 adds hsMainContext on every main request, up to the token cap (default 3000), until appendLog swaps in a new program. Rerolling or deleting responses does not clear the log either; only orders are filtered, through liveOrders. So the help text promises 'once' but the row actually attaches the log every turn.
v2.fix_plan: Owner decision. Option A (recommended, no behaviour change): fix the help text in src/ui/famtable.ts:249 so it states the 망상홈쇼핑 exception (text below). Option B: change behaviour so the HS log goes only to the request right after watching, e.g. store the lastBotKey at append time in HsLog (new field 'at') and have hsMainOn/hsMainContext require log.at === lastBotKey(chat). That would contradict the 11-12 owner rule that everything watched must reach the main model, so A is preferred. Do NOT change hslog persistence or the MAIN_CONTEXT guide wording under option A.

evidence: `await write((it) => removeItem(it, value, 'drop', 'manual', '', { key }));` — anchor is ''. core/items.ts movedNow (606-614) only takes `l.by === 'story' && l.anchor === lastAnchor`; recentItemLog (718-724) requires `l.anchor && keys.has(l.anchor)`. By contrast merge is anchored on purpose (ui/items.ts 457-459: 「합친 기록은 마지막 응답에 묶어 다음 요청 This turn에 넘긴다」).
scenario: 소지품 창에서 「우산」을 버리기 한다. 다음 메인 요청에는 목록에서 우산이 말없이 빠질 뿐 「버렸다」는 줄이 없어, 모델이 여전히 우산을 들고 있는 것처럼 쓰거나 왜 없는지 모른다.
fix_sketch: 버리기 기록을 lastBotKey로 묶고 「This turn: dropped X」 줄을 movedNow(또는 같은 자리)에 더한다. 삭제(purge)는 지금처럼 넘기지 않음.

So a manual drop never reaches This turn, and the item just disappears from the list (liveItems hides outHow items). The anchor '' is deliberate: outAt = anchor, so a manual drop is not undone by rerolling. That means the fix must not just pass lastBotKey as the anchor. The same gap was fixed for merges (11-08, 「합쳐도 본편이 몰랐다」) and for story removals (movedNow, 11-12, 「본편도 알아야 다음 응답에서 그 물건을 도로 입히지 않는다」). A dropped equipped jacket or umbrella can be written back in by the model. The list header 'nothing else is on hand' softens this, hence medium rather than high.

This uses the item's outKey, which ui/items.ts:494 already sets to messageKey of the last message at drop time; that equals lastBotKey(chat) at the next request when the user dropped after a bot reply. Add `...droppedNow(it, lastBotKey(chat))` to the events array in inventoryText next to movedNow. Do NOT change the anchor '' passed in ui/items.ts:495 (that would make a reroll undo the drop), and do NOT report purge (purgeItem removes the log on purpose). Optionally add a unit case to the existing items test next to the movedNow/mergedNow cases.
v2.side_effects: A new event line in [Inventory] 'This turn' for one request after a manual drop. If the user drops several items in one turn, they are all listed. Items dropped before any bot reply (outKey is a user/first message) are not reported, same as today. No guide text changes.
v2.proof: Walk: the chat ends with char message K. The user drops 우산 → item {outHow:'drop', outAt:'', outKey:K}, log {what:'drop', by:'manual', anchor:''}. On the next send, lastBotKey = K. movedNow filters by==='story' → [], recentItemLog filters l.anchor truthy → excluded, liveItems hides outHow → 우산 is simply absent and no 'dropped' line appears anywhere in the request.

title_ko: 게시판 「컨텍스트 토큰 상한」과 글 수가 게시판마다 따로 적용돼 넷을 다 쓰면 네 배가 된다
evidence: `for (const { view } of boardsOn) { … parts.push({ cap: GN_CONTEXT.tokens, build: (cap) => withCap(GN_CONTEXT, 'tokens', cap, () => mainContext(st, userNick(ss), rule, focus)) }); }` — one part per board, each with the full shared cap (3000) and full post/DM counts; the same MAIN_CONTEXT rule text is repeated in every block. The value is shown once under 「네 게시판이 같이 쓰는 값」 (famtable.ts 147-151) and `gen.ctx_total` defaults to 0 (unlimited).
scenario: 네 게시판에 모두 기록이 있으면 설정에 3000토큰이라고 적혀 있어도 메인 요청에는 최대 12000토큰과 같은 머리말 네 번이 붙는다.
fix_sketch: 게시판들을 한 묶음으로 만들어 상한을 한 번만 적용하거나(머리말도 한 번), 설정 글에 「게시판마다」라고 적는다.

v2.reasoning: The code does what the finding describes. In src/body.ts moduleContext (lines ~426-434), every board with 「컨텍스트 포함」 on adds its own ContextPart, and each one gets cap = GN_CONTEXT.tokens (the shared $lb_cfg_lb-gn adv ctx_tokens, default 3000 in src/core/advanced.ts:95) plus the same post/comment/DM counts. That is not a bug, though. It is how the owner decided shared values work: the 2026-11-11 note in src/core/boards.ts says the other board settings use "괴담넷 자리의 값 하나를 같이 쓴다", meaning all four boards read one value. They do: boardView passes non-OWN $lb_cfg_lb-gn.* keys through unchanged, so each board reads the same number. Nothing in the UI says the number is a combined total. famtable.ts:150 (「최대 양 … 토큰 상한」, '토큰 상한을 넘는 것은 빼요.') sits under the heading 「네 게시판이 같이 쓰는 값」, which means "one value for all boards", and the same group applies 게시글/쪽지 counts per board. A combined limit for the main request already exists as gen.ctx_total (advanced.ts:61, applied by budget.ts fitTotal). Its hint says it is the sum across features, so the per-board cap is per board and the total is a separate setting. The claim that the same header is repeated four times is also wrong: mainContextRules (gnetPrompt.ts:335) reads MAIN_CONTEXT from each site's own guide (SITE_GUIDE gn/gal/wpf/sm → GNet/Gal/Wpf/Salmon), and each block carries its own site name (BOARD_NAME). The only real gap is that the helper text does not say "게시판마다". That is a wording/taste question, not a hollow setting. This loop already existed in released v0.21.11 (782dca17c body.ts:407-410).
v2.fix_plan: No code change needed. If the owner wants it clearer, the only change would be visible help text in src/ui/famtable.ts line 150 (the 「최대 양」 row): say that the limit applies to each board separately and that the overall limit is 「컨텍스트 총 상한」. That needs owner approval. Do NOT change moduleContext into one combined board part: per-site guides (MAIN_CONTEXT per site) and per-site names in the payload must stay separate.
v2.proof: Traced by hand. applyAdvanced(ss) sets GN_CONTEXT.tokens = advNum(state,'gn','ctx_tokens') (advanced.ts:280) once. In the loop, each board view builds a part with cap 3000, and withCap sets the same cap for each mainContext call. fitTotal(parts, ctx_total=0) returns all texts unchanged (budget.ts:54). So with four boards turned on, up to 4×3000 tokens are added. That matches the per-board meaning of the shared value. Each part's rule comes from policySections(..., SITE_GUIDE[site]), a different guide per site.
v2.side_effects: None, since no change is proposed. A help-text edit would touch only famtable.ts line 150 and needs the owner's approval.

title_ko: 망상홈쇼핑을 꺼도 시청 기록은 메인 요청에 계속 붙는다
evidence: hsMainOn checks only `$hs_log` present + `$hs_main` + kinds; it does not read hsSettings(vars).on, whereas homeshopBlock (homeshop.ts 640) starts with `if (!s.on) return ''`. Probe: hsMainOn({ $hs_on: '0', $hs_log: <one say line> }) === true.
scenario: 방송을 본 뒤 망상홈쇼핑 기능 자체를 끈다. 호출·방청 줄은 사라지지만 시청 기록 묶음(최대 3000토큰)은 매 턴 계속 간다.
fix_sketch: hsMainOn에 hsSettings(vars).on 조건을 더한다.

v2.reasoning: hsMainOn (src/core/hslog.ts 144) really does ignore hsSettings(vars).on ($hs_on). But nothing else in the code works the other way. The other 「메인 요청에 넘기기」 switches also ignore their feature's own on/off. shopMain (src/core/shopctx.ts 42-46) reads only shopMainKey and never shopSettings().on. In body.ts moduleContext (lines 412-446), the boards and 괴담톡 are gated only by gnetSettings().context and phoneSettings().context. hsBuyPasses (hslog.ts 143) also reads only $hs_main. The 망상홈쇼핑 row in the shop table has its own 「컨텍스트 포함」 switch ($hs_main, famtable.ts 243/247). That switch is how the user stops the log. Turning $hs_on off only stops new broadcasts and hides the site (app.ts 1947: 「꺼도 카드로 접속하면 그 탭에서 열린다」). What the user already watched stays a story fact, just as past shop purchases do. The 3000-token cap and ctx_total still apply. This is an intentional and consistent split between 「기능 켬」 and 「컨텍스트 포함」, not a bug.
v2.fix_plan: No change. If the owner wants turning the feature off to also cut the log, add `&& hsSettings(vars).on` to hsMainOn in src/core/hslog.ts. That would make it the only feature that behaves this way, unlike the shop, malls and boards.
v2.proof: Walk: vars={$hs_on:'0',$hs_log:'[...]'} gives hsMainSettings.on = ($hs_main !== '0') = true, kinds = all, so hsMainOn = true and the log is sent. The same walk on the shop side: vars={$sh_on:'0'} gives shopMain(vars,'shop').on = true, so shop context is sent too. The behavior is the same in both features, on purpose.

title_ko: 괴담톡 보기 전용 방에서 본 대화는 메인 요청에 전혀 들어가지 않는다
evidence: Header comment: 「내가 끼지 않는 방이라 괴담톡 대화 기록(PState)과 따로 둔다. 선톡·새로고침·채팅 반영에는 섞이지 않는다.」 Rooms live in `$ph_views`; phone mainContext (phone.ts 1054-1088) reads only PState rooms and bulletins; body.ts moduleContext has no part for view rooms and there is no setting for it.
scenario: 보기 전용 방에서 인물들끼리 나눈 대화를 읽고 이야기에서 그 내용을 언급해도, 메인 모델은 그 대화를 받은 적이 없어 모른다. 11-06 설계(섞지 않음)와 「한 일은 전부 닿아야 한다」는 요구가 부딪힌다.
fix_sketch: 그대로 둘지, 「읽기만 한 대화」라는 표시(access)를 달아 넘기는 켬/끔 값을 둘지 정한다.

v2.reasoning: It is true that view-only rooms ($ph_views, src/core/phoneView.ts) never reach the main request. readViews is used only in src/ui/phone.ts (UI and the room's own generation), and moduleContext in body.ts has no part for them. But these rooms hold 사이드스토리 (「본편에 안 나온 짧은 대화」) and 혼잣말 / 다중인격 혼잣말 (a character's inner thoughts). The player character never witnessed any of it. Sending it to the main model would leak hidden thoughts and offscreen talk into the scene as known facts. That is a metagame leak, not a missing feed. The 「한 일은 전부 닿아야 한다」 rule covers what the user did inside a feature. In these rooms the user takes no part (「내가 끼지 않는 방」). Keeping them out is a coherent design, not a plumbing hole. No code path is wrong here. This is a product question, not a defect.
v2.fix_plan: No code change. If the owner later wants it, add an opt-in switch (e.g. $ph_view_context, default off) and a part in body.ts moduleContext that sends only the side-story rooms, labelled as 「the user only read this; characters do not know it」. That label sentence would go in a guide section, not in code. Do not change the defaults.
v2.proof: grep: PH_VIEWS/readViews appear only in src/ui/phone.ts (678, 742, 776, 787, 1156, 1288, 1304) and in flow/flowpage (settings only). phoneMainContext reads only PState and bulletins. Not a bug: the header says these are scenes the user does not take part in.
